Title is in the friend. The gift over to the sister's children who reach 25 is an executory interest that depends on the lot being used for church purposes, and that use could begin at any time, even after the sister and all her children have died. Because it is not certain to vest or fail within a life in being plus 21 years, it violates the Rule Against Perpetuities and is void. The team note is wrong. The sister being a life in being does not help, because the church-use condition is not confined to her lifetime. With the gift over struck, the friend's fee simple becomes absolute.

CONFIDENCE: 90
